verdict.rationale: Inngest functions are plain code triggered by events/cron/CLI/API and run on your own infra or self-hosted servers, with a REST API and CLI for invoking functions, fetching traces, and running tests headlessly in CI (inngest-docs-7, inngest-docs-8, inngest-docs-9, inngest-docs-14, inngest-gh-1). Community reports confirm production use in automated background/queue pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/GitHub Actions integration doc, and no independent benchmark of headless CI runs.
